sub.en: Look at the sentences. Where do just, already and yet go — and which one goes at the end?

items.q: I ___ bought it — the box is still on the table.
items.why: just and already go between have and the past participle. yet goes at the end, and only in negatives and questions.

acts.title: One object each
text: We asked four people to name the one possession they would not sell, and to say what they had done with it.

SANDRA, 26. “My scooter. It’s brand new — I’ve only had it three weeks and I haven’t taken it out of the city yet. The seat is made of leather and it’s bright blue and shiny. I’ve already ridden it in the rain once, which I did not enjoy.”

OMAR, 51. “A pale grey wallet. It isn’t valuable and it isn’t even nice: it’s thin, it’s plastic, and my daughter gave it to me when she was nine. I’ve never lost it. I’ve lost two phones, a passport and, once, a car, but not this.”

DANA, 34. “An antique metal box that belonged to my grandmother. I’ve had it for twenty years and I’ve never opened it, because the key disappeared before I was born. I could break it open. I have already decided that I am not going to.”
MARAT, 40. “My bank card, honestly. Everything else I have lost, broken or given away. I bought a beautiful old leather bag in 2019 and I have used it exactly twice.”

items.q: The two words that mean “bought very recently”.
The word that goes at the end of a negative to mean “not up to now”.
The word that means “not once in my life”, used between have and the verb.
The preposition Dana uses before “twenty years”.

tts: My favourite possession is definitely my scooter. It’s brand new. I only got it a few weeks ago.
Riding it is great fun and the feel of the cool wind is wonderful, especially in this hot weather. And just looking at it brings a smile to my face.
I love the colour and the design of it, and it’s so bright and shiny! The seat’s made of leather, so it’s very comfortable to ride.

write.q: Describe one possession you would not sell: 6 sentences. Say what it is made of, use two adjectives in the right order, and include one sentence with just, one with already, one with yet and one with a finished past time.
write.model: My favourite possession is an old brown leather bag that belonged to my father. It’s made of leather and it’s heavier than anything else I own. I’ve just had it repaired for the second time. I’ve already decided that I will keep it even when it stops closing properly. I haven’t used it for work yet, because I’m afraid of the rain. My father bought it in 1994, which makes it older than I am.

speak.q: Describe a possession out loud in five sentences: what it is, what it is made of, one thing you’ve just done with it, one thing you haven’t done yet, and when you got it.
speak.model: My favourite thing is a small metal box. It’s made of metal and it’s heavier than it looks. I’ve just found it again after two years. I haven’t opened it yet — the key disappeared. My grandmother gave it to me in 2004.
